answer: Per-identity proof of space-time: each key plots 64 GB of Argon2 data salted with its own pubkey (~2 h to build, so it can't be regenerated on demand) and must return a beacon-chosen leaf within 1 s at 3 random moments per epoch. Plots can't be shared, so sybils named ivory, onyx and jetty on one box need 3 separate plots or fail together. A 1,000-key farm keeps 64 TB online, ~$1,500/month in SSD, vs ~3 POA per passing answer; one missed proof escrows rewards 2 epochs.
